_why: Slice-04 preconditions only. Every value here is an INPUT the producer is allowed to publish on the hourly projection, never an expected rendering: the oracle lives in the assertions. Hours are declared by ROLE, not by clock time -- `window_hour` is planted at whatever hour that day's own published best_window starts in, and `neighbour_hours` at every other planted hour -- so the fixture keeps meaning if a future morning moves a window. Three deliberate traps: the published weakest_link is never the lowest of its four values, so a page that marked the shortest bar would pass nothing here; every neighbour hour is MORE attractive than the window hour, so averaging, interpolating or falling back to an adjacent hour is visible; and one day's four values are disjoint from the other's, so a section that read the wrong day's hour cannot round to the right answer.
